--!strict
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Rules = require(Shared.Rules)
local Catalog = require(Shared.PetCatalog)
local Progression = require(Shared.Progression)
local ShopCatalog = require(Shared.ShopCatalog)
local UpgradeCatalog = require(Shared.UpgradeCatalog)
local EggProcessor = require(script.Parent.EggProcessor)
local PlayerSession = {}
PlayerSession.__index = PlayerSession

function PlayerSession.new(userId: number, name: string, plotIndex: number)
	local self = setmetatable({}, PlayerSession)
	self.userId, self.name, self.plotIndex = userId, name, plotIndex
	self.revision = 0
	-- Verified by CommerceService per visit; never serialized or reset with coins.
	self.entitlements = {}
	self:Reset()
	return self
end

function PlayerSession:Reset()
	-- A debug gameplay reset must never re-deliver an acknowledged purchase.
	self.purchaseReceipts=self.purchaseReceipts or {}
	self.crateCredits=self.crateCredits or 0
	self.guaranteedLuckRolls=self.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0
	self.commerceAutomatic=self.commerceAutomatic or {AutoCollectEggs=true,AutoMerge=true}
	self.coins, self.capacity, self.luck = Config.StartingCoins, Config.StartingSlots, 0
	self.eggSpeedLevel, self.plotSizeLevel, self.rollSlotsUnlocked = 0, 0, 1
	self.eggCarry={count=0,value=0}
	local finishCredits = if self.eggProcessor then self.eggProcessor.finishCredits else 0
	self.eggProcessor = EggProcessor.New()
	self.eggProcessor.finishCredits = finishCredits
	self.enemyKills=0
 self.incomeLevel=0
 self.promotion,self.recruitTier=1,1
 self.frontierWins,self.kingCleared={},false
 self.dataRevision,self.legacyCapacityGrant=Config.DataRevision,0
 self.tutorial={}
 self.saveStatus=self.saveStatus or "loading"
 self.saveMessage=self.saveMessage or "Loading your flock…"
	self.pets, self.slots, self.firstWins, self.raidPaid = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self.discovered = {}
	-- Nil means automatic; an empty list is an intentionally empty manual army.
	self.armySelection = nil :: {string}?
	self.campUnlocked, self.rollReadyAt, self.rollRevealAt = 1, 0, 0
	self.armyState, self.outgoing, self.incoming, self.defending = "Home", nil, nil, nil
	self.stationedAt = nil
	self.awayPets={}
	self.passiveEarned, self.battleEarned, self.returnAt = 0, 0, 0
	self.sessionIncome={eggs=0,battle=0,territory=0}
	self.debugNext, self.debugRandom = nil, nil
	self.lastResult, self.banner = "Collect eggs, then walk onto the green sell pad.", ""
	for slot, species in Config.StarterFlock do
		local pet = self:AddPet(species, 1)
		pet.investment = 0 -- Free birds have no cash purchase to refund.
		self.slots[slot] = pet.id
	end
	self.offer = {id=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), species="Duck", starter=true,
		level=1, price=Config.Economy.StarterRecruitPrice}
	self.offers={[1]=self.offer}
	self.rollSlotCount=1 -- WorldService binds the available physical displays.
	self:Touch()
end

function PlayerSession:Touch()
	self.revision += 1
end

function PlayerSession:AddPet(species: string, stars: number)
	local pet = {id=HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), species=species, stars=1, level=1, favorite=false, collected=0,investment=Catalog[species].price}
	self.pets[pet.id] = pet
	if table.find(Catalog.Order, species) then self.discovered[species] = true end
	return pet
end

function PlayerSession:Capacity(): number
 return self.capacity + (if self.entitlements.BiggerArmy then ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus else 0)
end

function PlayerSession:CollectionLimit(): number
 return math.min(Config.LegacyCollectionLimit,
  Config.CollectionLimit + self.plotSizeLevel * UpgradeCatalog.ExtraChickensPerPlotLevel)
end

function PlayerSession:EggProductionMultiplier(): number
 return UpgradeCatalog.EggSpeedRates[self.eggSpeedLevel + 1]
  * (if self.entitlements.DoubleEggSpawn then 2 else 1)
end

function PlayerSession:AutomaticEnabled(key: string): boolean
 return self.entitlements[key]==true and self.commerceAutomatic[key]==true
end

function PlayerSession:PaidLuckMultiplier(): number
 return if self.entitlements.DoubleLuck and self.paidRandomAllowed==true then 2 else 1
end

function PlayerSession:LuckGuarantee()
 local schedule=ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck
 local count=self.guaranteedLuckRolls
 local index=math.floor(count/schedule.interval)%#schedule.sequence+1
 return {interval=schedule.interval,rollsRemaining=schedule.interval-count%schedule.interval,
  nextSpecies=schedule.sequence[index],sequence=table.clone(schedule.sequence)}
end

function PlayerSession:AdvanceGuaranteedLuck(): string?
 if self.entitlements.DoubleLuck~=true or self.paidRandomRestricted~=true then return nil end
 local guarantee=self:LuckGuarantee()
 self.guaranteedLuckRolls=(self.guaranteedLuckRolls+1)%(guarantee.interval*#guarantee.sequence)
 return if guarantee.rollsRemaining==1 then guarantee.nextSpecies else nil
end

function PlayerSession:EarnedAmount(amount: number, source: string): number
 local earned=source=="eggs" or source=="battle" or source=="territory"
 return amount * (if earned and self.entitlements.DoubleCash then 2 else 1)
end

function PlayerSession:Count(): number
	local count = 0
	for _ in self.pets do count += 1 end
	return count
end

function PlayerSession:FindSlot(id: string): number?
	for slot, petId in self.slots do if petId == id then return slot end end
	return nil
end

-- Automatic combat-power ranking. Equal-power purchases preserve the existing squad.
function PlayerSession:AutoBestPetIds()
	local ranked={}
	for id,pet in self.pets do
		table.insert(ranked,{id=id,power=Rules.PetPower(pet.species,pet.stars,pet.level),slot=self:FindSlot(id)})
	end
	table.sort(ranked,function(a,b)
		if a.power~=b.power then return a.power>b.power end
		if (a.slot~=nil)~=(b.slot~=nil) then return a.slot~=nil end
		if a.slot and b.slot then return a.slot<b.slot end
		return a.id<b.id
	end)
	local ids={}
	for i=1,math.min(self:Capacity(),#ranked) do table.insert(ids,ranked[i].id) end
	return ids
end

-- Existing deployment/reinforcement consumers use this desired roster contract.
function PlayerSession:BestPetIds()
	if self.armySelection==nil then return self:AutoBestPetIds() end
	local ids,seen={},{}
	for _,id in self.armySelection do
		if self.pets[id] and not seen[id] and #ids<self:Capacity() then
			seen[id]=true;table.insert(ids,id)
		end
	end
	return ids
end

function PlayerSession:RefreshArmy(): boolean
	-- BattleService owns physical relief handoffs while deployed.
	if self:IsArmyLocked() then return false end
	local best=self:BestPetIds()
	local chosen,slots={},{}
	for _,id in best do chosen[id]=true end
	for slot,id in self.slots do
		if slot<=self:Capacity() and chosen[id] then slots[slot]=id end
	end
	for _,id in best do
		local oldSlot=self:FindSlot(id)
		if not oldSlot or slots[oldSlot]~=id then
			for slot=1,self:Capacity() do if not slots[slot] then slots[slot]=id;break end end
		end
	end
	-- Manual ordering is explicit; automatic mode retains the stable slot behavior above.
	if self.armySelection~=nil then slots=table.clone(best) end
	local changed=false
	for slot,id in self.slots do if slots[slot]~=id then changed=true;break end end
	if not changed then for slot,id in slots do if self.slots[slot]~=id then changed=true;break end end end
	if changed then self.slots=slots;self:Touch() end
	return changed
end

local function selectedSet(session)
	local result={}
	for _,id in session:BestPetIds() do result[id]=true end
	return result
end

local function saleEligibility(session,id,selected): (boolean,string)
	local pet=if type(id)=="string" then session.pets[id] else nil
	if not pet then return false,"That chicken is no longer in your flock." end
	if pet.favorite then return false,"Favorite protected — unfavorite this chicken before selling." end
	if not session:IsPetHome(id) then return false,"This chicken is deployed or traveling." end
	if selected[id] then return false,"Selected for your army. Remove this chicken from the army before selling." end
	return true,"Reserve chicken — available to sell."
end

function PlayerSession:SaleEligibility(id): (boolean,string)
	return saleEligibility(self,id,selectedSet(self))
end

function PlayerSession:Lineup()
	local result = {}
	for slot=1, self:Capacity() do
		local pet = self.pets[self.slots[slot]]
		if pet then table.insert(result, {id=pet.id, species=pet.species, stars=pet.stars, level=pet.level, slot=slot}) end
	end
	return result
end

-- Physical home location determines egg production.
-- Every reserve stays home; deployed and incoming birds use battle actors
-- until its departure, defense or recovery transition has finished.
function PlayerSession:IsPetHome(id: string): boolean
	return self.pets[id]~=nil and not (self.awayPets and self.awayPets[id]) and (not self:IsArmyLocked() or self:FindSlot(id)==nil)
end

function PlayerSession:HomePets()
	local result={}
	for id,pet in self.pets do if self:IsPetHome(id) then table.insert(result,pet) end end
	table.sort(result,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
	return result
end

function PlayerSession:PetIncome(id: string): number
	local pet=self.pets[id]
	if not pet then return 0 end
	return Rules.Income(pet.species,pet.stars,pet.level,self.incomeLevel)
end

function PlayerSession:DisplayedPetIncome(species: string, stars: number, level: number?): number
 local raw=Rules.Income(species,stars,level,self.incomeLevel)
 return self:EarnedAmount(raw*self:EggProductionMultiplier(),"eggs")
end

function PlayerSession:Income(): number
	local income=0
	for id in self.pets do if self:IsPetHome(id) then income+=self:PetIncome(id) end end
	return income
end

function PlayerSession:IsArmyLocked(): boolean
	return self.armyState ~= "Home"
end

function PlayerSession:Credit(amount: number, source: string)
	assert(type(amount)=="number" and amount==amount and amount>=0 and amount<math.huge and amount%1==0,"Coin credits must be nonnegative whole numbers")
	if amount==0 then return 0 end
	amount=self:EarnedAmount(amount,source)
	self.coins += amount
	if source == "eggs" then self.passiveEarned += amount end
	if source == "battle" then self.battleEarned += amount end
	-- Session-only observation totals; never serialized or used to authorize a purchase.
	self.sessionIncome=self.sessionIncome or {eggs=0,battle=0,territory=0}
	if self.sessionIncome[source]~=nil then self.sessionIncome[source]+=amount end
	self:Touch()
	return amount
end

-- Unlocks are permanent, earned by distinct victories; the active squad is untouched.
function PlayerSession:UnlockProgress()
 local earned=Progression.EarnedRank(self.firstWins,self.frontierWins)
 if earned<=self.promotion then return false end
 self.promotion,self.recruitTier=earned,earned
 -- A victory may happen while the player is rolling. Preserve that reveal and offer;
 -- ranks change combat limits, not this offer or future roll odds.
 self.banner=Progression.Get(earned).name.." reached! Higher army capacity unlocked."
 self:Touch()
 return true
end

function PlayerSession:Completed(): boolean
	for i=1,#Progression.Camps(1) do if not self.firstWins[i] then return false end end
	return true
end

function PlayerSession:NextSlot()
 local rule=Config.SlotUnlocks[self.capacity]
 if not rule then return nil end
 local unlocked=rule.capacity<=Progression.Get(self.promotion).capacityCap
 local requiredRank=1
 while requiredRank<Progression.Count() and rule.capacity>Progression.Get(requiredRank).capacityCap do requiredRank+=1 end
 return {capacity=rule.capacity,displayCapacity=rule.capacity+(if self.entitlements.BiggerArmy then ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus else 0),price=rule.price,unlocked=unlocked,
  requirement=if unlocked then "Buy one more deployment slot" else "Reach "..Progression.Get(requiredRank).name}
end

function PlayerSession:GlobalUpgrade(kind: string)
	local current=if kind=="Income" then self.incomeLevel else self.luck
	local prices=if kind=="Income" then Config.IncomePrices else Config.LuckPrices
	local price=prices[current+1]
	if not price then return nil end
	local unlocked=kind=="Luck" or current+1<=self.promotion
	return {price=price,unlocked=unlocked,requirement=if unlocked then "" else "Reach "..Progression.Get(current+1).name}
end

-- Compare a reveal to the best owned squad, including pending replacements while away.
function PlayerSession:OfferAdvice(species: string, level: number?): (string, boolean)
	local best=self:AutoBestPetIds()
	if #best<self:Capacity() then
		return "Fills an army slot",true
	end
	local weakest=self.pets[best[#best]]
	if weakest and Rules.PetPower(species,1,level)>Rules.PetPower(weakest.species,weakest.stars,weakest.level) then
		return "Stronger next squad",true
	end
	local income=self:DisplayedPetIncome(species,1,level)
	return "Lays eggs worth $"..income.."/s at home",false
end

function PlayerSession:Snapshot(now: number)
	local rank=Progression.Get(self.promotion)
	local best=self:BestPetIds()
	local selected,deployed={},{}
	local deployedIds={}
	for _,id in best do selected[id]=true end
	if self:IsArmyLocked() then
		for _,pet in self:Lineup() do table.insert(deployedIds,pet.id);deployed[pet.id]=true end
	end
	local pets={}
	for _,pet in self.pets do
		local canSell,reason=saleEligibility(self,pet.id,selected)
		table.insert(pets,{id=pet.id,species=pet.species,stars=pet.stars,level=pet.level,favorite=pet.favorite,
			slot=self:FindSlot(pet.id),selected=selected[pet.id]==true,deployed=deployed[pet.id]==true,
			canSell=canSell,saleReason=reason,income=self:DisplayedPetIncome(pet.species,pet.stars,pet.level),home=self:IsPetHome(pet.id),
			nextIncome=if (pet.level or 1)<rank.levelCap then self:DisplayedPetIncome(pet.species,pet.stars,(pet.level or 1)+1) else nil,
			levelCap=rank.levelCap,upgradeLocked=(pet.level or 1)>=rank.levelCap,
			investment=pet.investment,refund=Rules.SellValue(pet.investment or Rules.Investment(pet.species,pet.level))})
	end
	table.sort(pets,function(a,b)
		if a.species~=b.species then return a.species<b.species end
		if a.stars~=b.stars then return a.stars>b.stars end
		return a.id<b.id
	end)
	local offers={}
	for slot=1,self.rollSlotCount or 1 do
		local value=self.offers and self.offers[slot]
		if value then
			local offer=table.clone(value);offer.slot=slot
			offer.advice,offer.improvesArmy=self:OfferAdvice(offer.species,offer.level)
			table.insert(offers,offer)
		end
	end
	local offer=offers[1]
	local campsWon=0
	for i=1,#Progression.Camps(1) do if self.firstWins[i] then campsWon+=1 end end
	local eggProduction=self:EggProductionMultiplier()
	local income=self:EarnedAmount(self:Income()*eggProduction,"eggs")
	return {nextSlot=self:NextSlot(),
		progression={rank=self.promotion,name=rank.name,total=Progression.Count(),capacityCap=rank.capacityCap+(if self.entitlements.BiggerArmy then ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus else 0),
			levelCap=rank.levelCap,ready=false,
            goal=Progression.NextGoal(self.firstWins,self.frontierWins,self.kingCleared),
            requirement=Progression.Requirement(math.min(self.promotion+1,4)),
			nextName=if self.promotion<Progression.Count() then Progression.Get(self.promotion+1).name else nil,
			recruitTier=self.recruitTier,recruitName=Progression.Get(self.recruitTier).name,nextUnlock=rank.nextUnlock},
		incomeUpgrade=self:GlobalUpgrade("Income"),luckUpgrade=self:GlobalUpgrade("Luck"),
		frontierWins=table.clone(self.frontierWins),kingCleared=self.kingCleared,
        firstWins=table.clone(self.firstWins),homeCount=#self:HomePets(),reserveCount=#pets-#best,homeIncome=income,incomeLevel=self.incomeLevel,
		tutorial=table.clone(self.tutorial),saveStatus=self.saveStatus,saveMessage=self.saveMessage,
		campsWon=campsWon,allCampsWon=self:Completed(),
		userId=self.userId,name=self.name,plotIndex=self.plotIndex,revision=self.revision,
		coins=self.coins,income=income,capacity=self:Capacity(),baseCapacity=self.capacity,count=#pets,pets=pets,discovered=table.clone(self.discovered),
		collectionLimit=self:CollectionLimit(),selectedIds=best,deployedIds=deployedIds,
		selectionMode=if self.armySelection==nil then "Auto" else "Manual",
		selectedCount=#best,deployedCount=#deployedIds,overflowCount=math.max(0,#pets-self:CollectionLimit()),
		offer=offer,offers=offers,rollSlotCount=self.rollSlotCount or 1,rollRemaining=math.max(0,self.rollReadyAt-now),odds=Rules.Odds(self.luck,self.recruitTier,self:PaidLuckMultiplier()),luck=self.luck,
		campUnlocked=self.campUnlocked,armyState=self.armyState,outgoing=self.outgoing,incoming=self.incoming,stationedAt=self.stationedAt,
		returnRemaining=math.max(0,self.returnAt-now),passiveEarned=self.passiveEarned,battleEarned=self.battleEarned,
		power=Rules.Power(self:Lineup()),deployed=#deployedIds,lastResult=self.lastResult,banner=self.banner}
end

-- The data envelope/lease belongs to DataService. This object owns its serializable player values.
function PlayerSession:ToData()
 local armySelection
 if self.armySelection~=nil then
  armySelection={}
  local seen={}
  for _,id in self.armySelection do
   if self.pets[id] and not seen[id] and #armySelection<self.capacity+ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus then
    seen[id]=true;table.insert(armySelection,id)
   end
  end
 end
	local pets={}
	for _,pet in self.pets do table.insert(pets,{id=pet.id,species=pet.species,level=pet.level,favorite=pet.favorite,collected=pet.collected or 0,
		investment=pet.investment or Rules.Investment(pet.species,pet.level)}) end
	table.sort(pets,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
	local wins={}
	for index,won in self.firstWins do if won then table.insert(wins,index) end end
	table.sort(wins)
 local frontier={}
 for i,won in self.frontierWins do if won then table.insert(frontier,i) end end
 table.sort(frontier)
	return {dataRevision=Config.DataRevision,legacyCapacityGrant=self.legacyCapacityGrant or 0,
		purchaseReceipts=table.clone(self.purchaseReceipts),crateCredits=self.crateCredits,commerceAutomatic=table.clone(self.commerceAutomatic),
		guaranteedLuckRolls=self.guaranteedLuckRolls,
		eggCarry=table.clone(self.eggCarry),enemyKills=self.enemyKills,
		eggProcessor=EggProcessor.Copy(self.eggProcessor),
		promotion=self.promotion,recruitTier=self.recruitTier,
		coins=self.coins,capacity=self.capacity,luck=self.luck,incomeLevel=self.incomeLevel,
		armySelection=armySelection,
		eggSpeedLevel=self.eggSpeedLevel,plotSizeLevel=self.plotSizeLevel,rollSlotsUnlocked=self.rollSlotsUnlocked,
		pets=pets,discovered=table.clone(self.discovered),firstWins=wins,frontierWins=frontier,kingCleared=self.kingCleared,tutorial=table.clone(self.tutorial),
		passiveEarned=self.passiveEarned,battleEarned=self.battleEarned}
end

local function numberIn(value,minimum,maximum,integer)
 return type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=minimum and value<=maximum and (not integer or value%1==0)
end

local function readWins(entries, limit, sparse)
	if type(entries)~="table" or #entries>limit then return nil end
	local wins,count={},0
	for key,index in entries do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(key,1,#entries,true) or not numberIn(index,1,limit,true) or wins[index] then return nil end
		wins[index]=true
	end
	if count~=#entries then return nil end
	local gap=false
	if not sparse then for i=1,limit do if not wins[i] then gap=true elseif gap then return nil end end end
	return wins
end

-- Revision 6 uses stable main-route IDs; appended camps can extend this list.
-- Earlier campaign layouts retain only IDs 1/2: their old third camp is not
-- the new Bucket Bastion and must never grant its first win.
local function readProgress(data, revision)
	if revision>=6 then return readWins(data.firstWins,#Progression.Camps(1)) end
 if revision>=4 then
  local old=readWins(data.firstWins,3)
  if not old then return nil end
  local wins={}
  for i=1,2 do if old[i] or (data.promotion or 1)>1 then wins[i]=true end end
  return wins
 end
	local selected=readWins(data.firstWins,5)
	if not selected or not numberIn(data.campaign,1,3,true)
		or type(data.campaignWins)~="table" or #data.campaignWins~=3 then return nil end
	local histories,count={},0
	for index,entries in data.campaignWins do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(index,1,3,true) then return nil end
		histories[index]=readWins(entries,5)
		if not histories[index] then return nil end
	end
	if count~=3 then return nil end
	local unlocked=1
	for index=1,2 do if histories[index][5] then unlocked=index+1 else break end end
	if data.campaign>unlocked then return nil end
	for index=unlocked+1,3 do if next(histories[index]) then return nil end end
	for i=1,5 do if (selected[i]==true)~=(histories[data.campaign][i]==true) then return nil end end
	-- Keep only clears of the two retained route IDs from the old campaigns.
	local wins={}
	for current,previous in {1,2} do if histories[1][previous] then wins[current]=true end end
	return wins
end

function PlayerSession:LoadData(data)
	if type(data)~="table" then return false,"Invalid saved profile." end
	local receipts={}
 if data.purchaseReceipts~=nil then
  if type(data.purchaseReceipts)~="table" then return false,"Invalid purchase history." end
  for id,productId in data.purchaseReceipts do
   if type(id)~="string" or #id<1 or #id>256 or not utf8.len(id)
    or not numberIn(productId,1,2^53-1,true) then return false,"Invalid purchase history." end
   receipts[id]=productId
  end
 end
 if not numberIn(data.crateCredits or 0,0,1e9,true) then return false,"Invalid saved crate count." end
 if not numberIn(data.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0,0,1e12,true) then return false,"Invalid saved guaranteed-offer progress." end
 local automatic={AutoCollectEggs=true,AutoMerge=true}
 if data.commerceAutomatic~=nil then
  if type(data.commerceAutomatic)~="table" then return false,"Invalid automatic settings." end
  for key,value in data.commerceAutomatic do
   if automatic[key]==nil or type(value)~="boolean" then return false,"Invalid automatic settings." end
   automatic[key]=value
  end
 end
 local revision=data.dataRevision or 1
	if not numberIn(revision,1,Config.DataRevision,true) then return false,"Unsupported saved profile revision." end
	-- Additive fields: never reduce the six slots an existing profile already had.
	local eggSpeedLevel = if data.eggSpeedLevel == nil then 0 else data.eggSpeedLevel
	local plotSizeLevel = if data.plotSizeLevel == nil then 0 else data.plotSizeLevel
	local rollSlotsUnlocked = if data.rollSlotsUnlocked == nil then Config.RollSlotsUnlocked else data.rollSlotsUnlocked
	if not numberIn(eggSpeedLevel,0,#UpgradeCatalog.EggSpeedPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(plotSizeLevel,0,#UpgradeCatalog.PlotPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(rollSlotsUnlocked,1,Config.RollSlotsUnlocked,true) then
		return false,"Invalid saved board upgrades."
	end
	local legacy=revision==1
	-- New carried eggs are distinct from the already-converted revision-1 egg bag.
	local carry=data.eggCarry or {count=0,value=0}
	local processor=EggProcessor.Read(data.eggProcessor)
	if not processor then return false,"Invalid saved egg processor." end
	if type(carry)~="table" or not numberIn(carry.count,0,1e12,true)
		or not numberIn(carry.value,0,1e12,true) or ((carry.count==0)~=(carry.value==0))
		or not numberIn(data.enemyKills or 0,0,1e12,true) then return false,"Invalid saved eggs or defeat count." end
	local promotion=if revision>=5 then data.promotion else 1
	local recruitTier=if revision>=5 then data.recruitTier else 1
	if not numberIn(promotion,1,Progression.Count(),true) or not numberIn(recruitTier,1,promotion,true) then
		return false,"Invalid saved promotion."
	end
	local capacity,grant=data.capacity,data.legacyCapacityGrant or 0
	if legacy then
		local mapped={[4]=6,[5]=6,[6]=6,[8]=12,[10]=12,[12]=12}
		capacity=if type(data.capacity)=="number" then mapped[data.capacity] else nil
		if not capacity then return false,"Invalid legacy deployment capacity." end
		grant=capacity
	elseif revision==2 then
		if not table.find({6,12,24},capacity) then return false,"Invalid previous deployment capacity." end
		if not numberIn(grant,0,12,true) or (grant~=0 and grant~=6 and grant~=12) then return false,"Invalid grandfathered capacity grant." end
	end
	-- Preserve the collection and balance; only deployed capacity is capped at ten.
	if revision<3 then capacity=math.min(capacity,Config.MaxSlots);grant=capacity end
	if not numberIn(grant,0,Config.MaxSlots,true) then return false,"Invalid capacity grant." end
	if not numberIn(data.coins,0,1e12) or not numberIn(capacity,Config.StartingSlots,Config.MaxSlots,true)
		or not table.find(Config.SlotLevels,capacity) or grant>capacity or not numberIn(data.luck,0,#Config.LuckPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(data.incomeLevel,0,#Config.IncomePrices,true) or type(data.pets)~="table" or #data.pets>Config.LegacyCollectionLimit
		or type(data.tutorial)~="table" then return false,"Invalid saved profile." end
	local converted=0
	if legacy then
		if not numberIn(data.eggBagCount or 0,0,1e12,true) or not numberIn(data.eggBagValue or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved egg bag." end
		converted=data.eggBagValue or 0
	end
	local pets,count={},0
	for index,pet in data.pets do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(index,1,#data.pets,true) or type(pet)~="table" or type(pet.id)~="string" or #pet.id<1 or #pet.id>64
			or not utf8.len(pet.id) or pets[pet.id] or type(pet.species)~="string" or not table.find(Catalog.Order,pet.species)
			or type(pet.favorite)~="boolean" or not numberIn(pet.collected or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken." end
		if legacy then
			if not numberIn(pet.cash or 0,0,1e10) or not numberIn(pet.eggCount or 0,0,1e6,true)
				or not numberIn(pet.eggTimer or 0,0,Config.LegacyEggLaySeconds) then return false,"Invalid saved egg value." end
			converted+=pet.cash or 0
		end
		local level=if revision<3 then 1 else pet.level
		if not numberIn(level,1,Config.MaxPetLevel,true) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken level." end
		local investment=if revision<5 then Rules.Investment(pet.species,level,true) else pet.investment
		if not numberIn(investment,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken investment." end
		pets[pet.id]={id=pet.id,species=pet.species,stars=1,level=level,favorite=pet.favorite,collected=math.ceil(pet.collected or 0),investment=math.ceil(investment)}
	end
	if count~=#data.pets then return false,"Invalid saved collection." end
	-- Optional additive field; existing profiles continue selecting their best chickens.
	local armySelection
	if data.armySelection~=nil then
		if type(data.armySelection)~="table" or #data.armySelection>capacity+ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus then
			return false,"Invalid saved army selection."
		end
		local seen,entries={},0
		armySelection={}
		for index,id in data.armySelection do
			entries+=1
			if entries>capacity+ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus or not numberIn(index,1,#data.armySelection,true)
				or type(id)~="string" or not pets[id] or seen[id] then
				return false,"Invalid saved army selection."
			end
			seen[id]=true;armySelection[index]=id
		end
		if entries~=#data.armySelection then return false,"Invalid saved army selection." end
	end
	-- Additive field in the current envelope: older saves seed their owned flock.
	-- Discovery survives sale/merge; an unbought roll offer never adds an entry.
	local discovered = {}
	if data.discovered ~= nil then
		if type(data.discovered) ~= "table" then return false,"Invalid saved chicken index." end
		for species, collected in data.discovered do
			if type(species) ~= "string" or not table.find(Catalog.Order, species) or type(collected) ~= "boolean" then
				return false,"Invalid saved chicken index."
			end
			if collected then discovered[species] = true end
		end
	end
	for _, pet in pets do discovered[pet.species] = true end
	if not numberIn(data.coins+converted,0,1e12) then return false,"Saved coin balance exceeds the supported limit." end
	local wins=readProgress(data,revision)
	if not wins then return false,"Invalid saved camp progress." end
 local frontier,king={},false
 if revision>=6 then
  frontier=readWins(data.frontierWins,#Progression.Outposts(),true)
  if not frontier or type(data.kingCleared)~="boolean" then return false,"Invalid saved exploration progress." end
  king=data.kingCleared
 elseif revision==5 then
  -- Preserve completed older stages as distinct outposts; never downgrade an earned tier.
  local old=readWins(data.firstWins,3)
  for tier=2,4 do
   local offset=(tier-2)*2
   if promotion>tier then frontier[offset+1],frontier[offset+2]=true,true
   elseif promotion==tier then
    if old[1] then frontier[offset+1]=true end
    if old[3] then frontier[offset+2]=true end
   end
  end
 end
 -- Older migrations earned ranks after two retained route camps. Preserve that
 -- entitlement without treating their old third landmark as Bucket Bastion.
 -- Current revision-6 profiles keep their saved rank; new unlocks need all camps.
 if revision<6 and wins[1] and wins[2] then
  local previousEarned=if frontier[4] then 4 elseif frontier[2] then 3 else 2
  if previousEarned>promotion then promotion,recruitTier=previousEarned,previousEarned end
 end
	local tutorial={}
	for _,key in {"rolled","bought","collected","collectedEggs","soldEggs","wonCamp","returned","upgraded"} do tutorial[key]=data.tutorial[key]==true end
	if not numberIn(data.passiveEarned or 0,0,1e12) or not numberIn(data.battleEarned or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved earnings." end
	-- Commit only after every field validates. Old egg values were already valued;
	-- never multiply them again, and omit them from the current save payload.
	self.purchaseReceipts,self.crateCredits,self.commerceAutomatic=receipts,data.crateCredits or 0,automatic
	self.guaranteedLuckRolls=(data.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0)%(ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck.interval*#ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck.sequence)
	self.dataRevision,self.legacyCapacityGrant=Config.DataRevision,grant
	self.eggSpeedLevel,self.plotSizeLevel,self.rollSlotsUnlocked=eggSpeedLevel,plotSizeLevel,rollSlotsUnlocked
	self.eggCarry={count=carry.count,value=carry.value};self.enemyKills=data.enemyKills or 0
	self.eggProcessor=processor
	-- Preserve saved ranks and validation; always use the best earned odds now.
	self.promotion,self.recruitTier=promotion,promotion
 self.frontierWins,self.kingCleared=frontier,king
	-- Preserve old saves: round any historical cents up once, never reset progress.
	self.coins,self.capacity,self.luck,self.incomeLevel=math.ceil(data.coins+converted),capacity,data.luck,data.incomeLevel
	self.pets,self.slots,self.firstWins,self.tutorial=pets,{},wins,tutorial
	self.armySelection=armySelection
	self.discovered = discovered
	self.passiveEarned,self.battleEarned=math.ceil(data.passiveEarned or 0),math.ceil(data.battleEarned or 0)
	self.armyState,self.outgoing,self.incoming,self.defending="Home",nil,nil,nil
	self.returnAt,self.stationedAt=0,nil
	self.campUnlocked=1
	while self.firstWins[self.campUnlocked] and self.campUnlocked<#Progression.Camps(1) do self.campUnlocked+=1 end
	self.offer,self.offers=nil,{}
	self:UnlockProgress();self:RefreshArmy();self:Touch()
	return true,if legacy then "Loaded and converted stored egg value to coins." else "Loaded."
end

function PlayerSession:Destroy()
	self.pets, self.slots = {}, {}
end

return PlayerSession

--!strict

local Rules = require(Shared.Rules)

local DuckAnimator = require(script.Parent.DuckAnimator)
local AppController = {}
AppController.__index = AppController
local C = Theme.Colors

function AppController.new()
	local self = setmetatable({connections = {}, requestId = 0, page = "Army", selected = nil,
		confirm = nil, panelKey = "", reducedMotion = false, toastSerial = 0, alive = true,
		recruitIntents = {}, recruitReceipts = {}}, AppController)
	self.audio = AudioController.new()
	self.feedback = ActionFeedback.new(self)
	self.eggs = EggController.new(self)
	self.commerce = CommerceController.new(self)
	self.progression=ProgressionBrowser.new(self)
	self.upgradeBoard=UpgradeBoardController.new(self)
	self.eggBoard=EggProcessorController.new(self)
	self.base, self.battle = BaseController.new(self), BattleController.new(self)
	return self
end

function AppController:Request(action, payload)
	if not Config.Features.Merging and (action=="OpenMerge" or action=="Merge" or action=="MergeAll") then return nil end
	self.requestId += 1
	local request = payload or {}
	request.action, request.id = action, self.requestId
	self.remotes.RequestAction:FireServer(request)
	return self.requestId
end


function AppController:NoticePosition()
	-- Menu feedback sits over the dimmed HUD, away from purchase controls.
	return if self.panel.Visible then UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,82) else UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,-140)
end

function AppController:Notify(text, ok)
	if not text or text == "" then return end
	self.toastSerial += 1
	local serial = self.toastSerial
	self.toast.Text, self.toast.TextColor3 = text, if ok == false then C.red else C.ink
	Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition())
	task.delay(if ok == false then 5 else 2, function()
		if self.alive and serial == self.toastSerial then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,false) end
	end)
end

function AppController:Pet(id)
	if not self.state or not id then return nil end
	for _, pet in self.state.pets do if pet.id == id then return pet end end
	return nil
end

-- Purchase classification describes selection, not a bird arriving at a battle.
-- Keep that identity independently of any encounter so late replication and a
-- later first deployment cannot drop the acknowledgement or replay an old one.
function AppController:TrackRecruit(result)
	local recruit, id = result.recruit, result.petId
	if type(recruit) ~= "table" or type(id) ~= "string"
		or (recruit.assignment ~= "Added" and recruit.assignment ~= "Replacement" and recruit.assignment ~= "Reserve") then return false end
	if self.recruitReceipts[id] then return true, false end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.recruitReceipts[id] = now + 600
	local pet = self:Pet(id)
	local definition = pet and Catalog[pet.species]
	local name = definition and definition.name or "Chicken"
	local assignment = recruit.assignment
	self.recruitIntents[id] = {petId = id, assignment = assignment, createdAt = now, expiresAt = now + 600,
		pendingBattleId = recruit.pendingBattleId, deferred = recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds == true,
		selectedOnce = assignment ~= "Reserve",
		homeAcknowledged = false, arrivalAcknowledged = false, contributionAcknowledged = false}
	local text
	if assignment == "Reserve" then
		text = name .. " · yard eggs +$" .. Theme.Money(pet and pet.income or 0) .. "/s"
	else
		text = if assignment == "Added" and type(recruit.selectedBefore) == "number" and type(recruit.selectedAfter) == "number"
			then "Squad " .. recruit.selectedBefore .. " → " .. recruit.selectedAfter else "Stronger chicken selected"
		if recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds then text ..= " · joins after this contest"
		elseif recruit.pendingBattleId then text ..= " · marching" end
	end
	self:Notify(text, true)
	self.feedback:Action("Buy")
	-- Bound presentation history independently of inventory size.
	local count, oldestId, oldest = 0, nil, math.huge
	for petId, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		count += 1
		if intent.createdAt < oldest then oldestId, oldest = petId, intent.createdAt end
	end
	if count > 24 and oldestId then self.recruitIntents[oldestId] = nil end
	return true, true
end

function AppController:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if not self.state then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	for id, expires in self.recruitReceipts do if now >= expires then self.recruitReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		local pet = self:Pet(id)
		if now >= intent.expiresAt or not pet then self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue end
		if intent.deferred then
			-- Buy confirms the active lock. BattleChanged uses another stream and
			-- may still cache the same encounter's earlier, unlocked NPC approach.
			-- Release on the state transition (or the actual new unit below), not
			-- that older snapshot. Same-ID holding can still confirm real arrival.
			if self.state.outgoing ~= intent.pendingBattleId or self.state.armyState == "Home" then intent.deferred = false end
		end
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then intent.selectedOnce = true
		elseif intent.selectedOnce then
			-- A better later roll can supersede a recruit before it arrives.
			self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue
		end
		if pet.home and not intent.homeAcknowledged and not intent.deferred then
			local model = self.base:HomePet(id)
			if model and model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then
				intent.homeAcknowledged = true
				self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
			end
		end
	end
end

function AppController:ObserveRecruitUnit(battle, unit, model)
	local intent = unit.petId and self.recruitIntents[unit.petId]
	local state = self.state
	if not intent or not state or state.outgoing ~= battle.id then return end
	local side = if battle.attacker == state.userId then "A" elseif battle.defender == state.userId then "B" else nil
	if not side or unit.side ~= side or not model or not model.PrimaryPart then return end
	if intent.deferred and battle.rosterLocked then return end
	if battle.phase ~= "Fight" and battle.phase ~= "Capture" and battle.phase ~= "Holding" then return end
	if (unit.hp or 0) <= 0 or unit.reinforcing or unit.retiring then return end
	local pet = self:Pet(unit.petId)
	if not pet or not self:IsSelected(pet) then return end
	intent.selectedOnce = true
	-- Both authoritative coordinates and the displayed rig must be at the site.
	local radius = battle.captureRadius or Config.CaptureRadius
	local position = model.PrimaryPart.Position
	if (unit.x - battle.x)^2 + (unit.z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2
		or (position.X - battle.x)^2 + (position.Z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2 then return end
	if intent.battleId ~= battle.id then
		intent.battleId = battle.id
		intent.pendingBattleId = nil
		intent.deferred = false
	end
	if not intent.arrivalAcknowledged then
		intent.arrivalAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.blue)
		if os.clock() - (self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice or -10) > 1.2 then
			self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice = os.clock()
			self:Notify((Catalog[pet.species] and Catalog[pet.species].name or "Chicken") .. " joined your army", true)
		end
	end
	if not intent.contributionAcknowledged and (unit.impactSerial or 0) > 0 then
		-- This may be the first replicated view after a hit already occurred. A
		-- quiet bird emphasis confirms it; never replay that old hit or sound.
		intent.contributionAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
		self.recruitIntents[unit.petId] = nil
	end
end

function AppController:SelectPet(id)
	self.selected, self.confirm = id, nil
	self:OpenPage("Army")
end

function AppController:OpenPage(page)
	if page=="Recruits" then page="Odds" end -- Older UI callbacks cannot reopen the removed selector.
	if page=="Sell" then page="Army" end -- Legacy navigation uses the Army inspector.
	if page=="Merge" and not self.mergeBrowser then return end
	if self.mergeBrowser and self.page=="Merge" and page~="Merge" then self.mergeBrowser:Close() end
	local switching=self.panel.Visible and not self.panelClosing
	self.panelClosing=false
	if not self.panel.Visible then self.previousSelection=GuiService.SelectedObject end
	self.page = page
	if page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Reset() end
	if page=="Shop" then self.commerce:Open() end
	if page=="Army" then self.chickenBrowser:OpenInventory() end
	local tint=Theme.HeaderColors[page] or Theme.ActionColors.navigation
	Theme.SetHeaderColor(self.panelHeader,tint)
	Theme.Surface(self.panel.Body,Theme.PageSurfaces[page] or C.panel)
	self.content.ScrollBarImageColor3=tint
	local icon=self.panelHeader.PageIcon
	icon.Visible=page=="Army" or page=="Upgrades" or page=="Odds" or page=="Merge" or page=="Shop" or page=="Index"
	icon.Image=if page=="Shop" then Theme.Assets.Shop elseif page=="Index" then Theme.Assets.Index
		elseif page=="Army" or page=="Merge" then Theme.Assets.Army else Theme.Assets.Luck
	self.panelTitle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if icon.Visible then 104 else 24,0)
	self.panelTitle.Size=UDim2.new(1,if icon.Visible then -204 else -132,1,0)
	self.panel.Visible, self.backdrop.Visible = true, true
	self:RenderPanel(true)
	Theme.Motion:OpenPanel(self.panel,self.backdrop,switching)
	if self.toastFrame.Visible then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition()) end
	if UserInputService.GamepadEnabled then GuiService.SelectedObject=if page=="Upgrades" then self.progression.closeButton else self.closeButton end
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("PetRollClosePanel",function(_,state)
		if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then self:ClosePanel() end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end,false,2500,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)
end

function AppController:ClosePanel()
	if not self.panel.Visible or self.panelClosing then return end
	self.panelClosing=true
	if self.page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Close() end
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollClosePanel")
	if GuiService.SelectedObject and GuiService.SelectedObject:IsDescendantOf(self.panel) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject=if self.previousSelection and self.previousSelection.Parent then self.previousSelection else nil
	end
	Theme.Motion:ClosePanel(self.panel,self.backdrop,function()
		self.panelClosing=false
		if self.toastFrame.Visible then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition()) end
	end)
	self.confirm = nil
end

function AppController:TogglePage(page)
	self.audio:Play("Click")
	if self.panel.Visible and not self.panelClosing and self.page == page then self:ClosePanel() else self:OpenPage(page) end
end

function AppController:BuildUI()
	Theme.Motion:Reset()
	Theme.Motion:SetReduced(self.reducedMotion)
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("PetRollGui")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.ZIndexBehavior = "PetRollGui", false, Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	-- The backdrop covers the viewport; the HUD reserves horizontal space for Roblox controls.
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None
	gui.SafeAreaCompatibility = Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.None
	gui.DisplayOrder, gui.Parent = 5, playerGui
	self.gui = gui
	local shell = Theme.Frame(gui,"Shell",UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	shell.BackgroundTransparency=1
	local scale=Instance.new("UIScale");scale.Parent=shell
	self.hud=HudController.new(self,shell)
	local backdrop=Theme.Frame(shell,"Backdrop",UDim2.fromScale(1,1),C.dark)
	backdrop.BackgroundTransparency,backdrop.Visible,backdrop.Active=0.44,false,true
	backdrop.ZIndex,self.backdrop=10,backdrop
	Theme.Round(backdrop,0)
	local panel=Theme.Frame(shell,"Panel",UDim2.fromOffset(1120,660))
	panel.BackgroundTransparency=1
	panel.AnchorPoint,panel.Position,panel.Visible=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),false
	panel.ZIndex,panel.Active,self.panel=11,true,panel
	self.panelMotionScale=Theme.Motion:Scale(panel)
	local body=Theme.Frame(panel,"Body",UDim2.new(1,0,1,-96))
	body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,96)
	Theme.Surface(body)
	self.panelBody=body
	self.panelHeader,self.panelTitle=Theme.Header(panel,"Header","Your Chickens!",Theme.HeaderColors.Army)
	local close=Theme.ActionButton(self.panelHeader,"Close","X",function() self.audio:Play("Click");self:ClosePanel() end,Theme.Arcade.red)
	close.Position,close.Size,close.TextSize=UDim2.new(1,-84,0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(84,84),60
	self.closeButton=close
	local content=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	content.Name,content.Position,content.Size="Content",UDim2.fromOffset(20,114),UDim2.new(1,-40,1,-134)
	content.BackgroundTransparency,content.BorderSizePixel,content.ZIndex=1,0,2
	content.ScrollBarThickness,content.ScrollBarImageColor3=6,Theme.Arcade.green
	content.AutomaticCanvasSize,content.CanvasSize,content.Parent=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,UDim2.new(),panel
	local padding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft,padding.PaddingTop,padding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6),UDim.new(0,5),UDim.new(0,10)
	padding.Parent=content
	self.content=content
	local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding,list.SortOrder,list.Parent=UDim.new(0,12),Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,content
	self.contentLayout=list
	self.chickenBrowser=ChickenBrowser.new(self,panel)
	self.mergeBrowser=if MergeBrowser then MergeBrowser.new(self,panel) else nil
	self.shopBrowser=ShopBrowser.new(self,panel)
	self.indexBrowser=IndexBrowser.new(self,panel)
	self.progression:Mount(panel)
	table.insert(self.connections,list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() self:FitPanel() end))
	self.toastFrame=Theme.Frame(shell,"Notification",UDim2.fromOffset(420,64))
	Theme.Surface(self.toastFrame)
	self.toastFrame.AnchorPoint,self.toastFrame.Position=Vector2.new(0.5,1),UDim2.new(0.5,0,1,-140)
	self.toastFrame.Visible,self.toastFrame.ZIndex=false,20
	self.toast=Theme.Label(self.toastFrame,"Toast","",21)
	self.toast.Position,self.toast.Size,self.toast.TextXAlignment=UDim2.fromOffset(14,7),UDim2.new(1,-28,1,-14),Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local function resize()
		local available=gui.AbsoluteSize
		if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
		-- Fit the complete design to both axes. Wide, short windows must not enlarge menus.
		-- The 1120 x 660 menu occupies at most 76% x 77% of the viewport.
		local factor=math.min(available.X/1480,available.Y/860,1.1)
		local width,height=available.X/factor,available.Y/factor
		scale.Scale,shell.Size=factor,UDim2.fromScale(1/factor,1/factor)
		self.uiScale,self.panelMaxHeight=factor,math.max(200,math.min(660,height-32))
		self.panelMaxWidth=math.min(1120,width-40)
		panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.panelMaxWidth,self.panelMaxHeight)
		self:FitPanel()
		self.hud:Resize(width,height,factor)
		self.toastFrame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(420,width-32),64)
		if self.state and self.panel.Visible then self:RenderPanel(true) end
	end
	table.insert(self.connections,gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize))
	resize()
end

function AppController:FitPanel()
	if not self.contentLayout or not self.panelMaxHeight then return end
	if self.page=="Merge" then
		self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(860,self.panelMaxWidth),math.min(510,self.panelMaxHeight));return
	end
	if self.page=="Shop" then
		-- Match the current linked Figma viewport, not the archived responsive shell.
		local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
		local factor=math.max(self.uiScale or 1,0.1)
		local fit=math.max(0.01,math.min(1,available.X*0.90/1080,(available.X-24)/1080,
			available.Y*0.90/740,(available.Y-24)/740))
		self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(1080*fit/factor,740*fit/factor)
		return
	end
	if self.page=="Army" then
		-- Current Figma 221:2294: one scale, fixed four-column landscape layout.
		local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
		local factor=math.max(self.uiScale or 1,0.1)
		local fit=math.max(0.01,math.min(1.1,(available.X-24)/1536,available.X*0.96/1536,
			(available.Y-24)/1024,available.Y*0.94/1024))
		self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(1536*fit/factor,1024*fit/factor)
		return
	end
	if self.page=="Upgrades" then
		-- Figma 7:676 at the established, uniformly fitted menu scale.
		self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(1120,660)
		return
	end
	if self.page=="Index" then
		self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.panelMaxWidth,self.panelMaxHeight)
		return
	end
	local contentHeight=self.contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y/((self.uiScale or 1)*self.panelMotionScale.Scale)
	local height=math.min(self.panelMaxHeight,math.max(300,math.ceil(contentHeight)+150))
	self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.panelMaxWidth,height)
end

function AppController:Counts()
	local state = self.state or {}
	local count = state.count or #(state.pets or {})
	local capacity = state.capacity or Config.StartingSlots
	local selected = state.selectedCount
	if selected == nil then selected = if state.selectedIds then #state.selectedIds else math.min(count, capacity) end
	local deployed = state.deployedCount
	if deployed == nil then
		deployed = if state.deployedIds then #state.deployedIds elseif state.armyState and state.armyState ~= "Home" then state.deployed or 0 else 0
	end
	return count, state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit, capacity, selected, deployed
end

function AppController:PetIncome(pet)
	if type(pet.income) == "number" then return pet.income end

end

function AppController:IsSelected(pet)
	if pet.selected ~= nil then return pet.selected == true end
	if self.state.selectedIds then return table.find(self.state.selectedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:IsDeployed(pet)
	if pet.deployed ~= nil then return pet.deployed == true end
	if self.state.deployedIds then return table.find(self.state.deployedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return self.state.armyState ~= "Home" and pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:Groups()
	local groups, byKey = {}, {}
	for _, pet in self.state.pets or {} do
		local key = groupKey(pet)
		local group = byKey[key]
		if not group then
			group = {key = key, species = pet.species, stars = pet.stars, level = pet.level or 1, pets = {}, sellable = {}, ready = 0, deployed = 0, favorites = 0, income = 0}
			byKey[key] = group;table.insert(groups, group)
		end
		table.insert(group.pets, pet)
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then group.ready += 1 end
		if self:IsDeployed(pet) then group.deployed += 1 end
		if pet.canSell == true then table.insert(group.sellable, pet) end
		if pet.favorite then group.favorites += 1;group.favorite = group.favorite or pet end
		group.income += self:PetIncome(pet)
	end
	for _, group in groups do
		table.sort(group.sellable, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
		group.representative = group.sellable[1] or group.favorite or group.pets[1]
		group.protected = #group.pets - #group.sellable
	end
	table.sort(groups, function(a, b)
		local ap, bp = Rules.PetPower(a.species, a.stars, a.level), Rules.PetPower(b.species, b.stars, b.level)
		if ap ~= bp then return ap > bp end
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	return groups, byKey
end

function AppController:RenderPanel(force)
	if not self.state or not self.panel.Visible then return end
	local browsing=self.page=="Army"
	local merging=self.page=="Merge" and self.mergeBrowser~=nil
	local shopping,indexing=self.page=="Shop",self.page=="Index"
	local upgrading=self.page=="Upgrades"
	self.progression.root.Visible=upgrading
	self.content.Visible,self.chickenBrowser.root.Visible=not browsing and not merging and not shopping and not indexing and not upgrading,browsing
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser.root.Visible=merging end
	self.panelHeader.Visible,self.panelBody.Visible=not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading,not shopping and not browsing and not upgrading
	self.shopBrowser.root.Visible,self.indexBrowser.root.Visible=shopping,indexing
	if upgrading then
		self:FitPanel();self.progression:Render();return
	end
	if shopping then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Shop!";self:FitPanel();self.shopBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if indexing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Chicken Index!";self:FitPanel();self.indexBrowser:Render(force);return
	end
	if merging then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Merge Chickens!"
		self:FitPanel();self.mergeBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	if browsing then
		self.panelTitle.Text="Your Chickens!"
		self:FitPanel()
		self.chickenBrowser:Render(force)
		return
	end
	local state = self.state
	local keys = {self.page, tostring(self.selected), tostring(self.confirm), tostring(state.capacity), tostring(state.luck), tostring(state.incomeLevel), state.armyState, tostring(state.campsWon),tostring(state.incoming)}
	local p=state.progression
	if p then table.insert(keys,p.rank..":"..p.recruitTier..":"..tostring(p.goal)..":"..tostring(p.requirement)..":"..tostring(state.kingCleared)) end
	if self.page == "Settings" then table.insert(keys, tostring(state.saveStatus));table.insert(keys, tostring(state.saveMessage)) end
	local key = table.concat(keys, "|")
	if not force and key == self.panelKey then return end
	self.panelKey = key
	local scroll = self.content.CanvasPosition
	if self.renderedPage ~= self.page or self.renderedSelection ~= self.selected or self.renderedConfirm ~= self.confirm then scroll = Vector2.zero end
	self.renderedPage, self.renderedSelection, self.renderedConfirm = self.page, self.selected, self.confirm
	self:ClearPanel()
	if self.page == "Odds" then
		self.panelTitle.Text = "Roll Odds"
		for _, id in Catalog.Order do
			local chance = state.odds and state.odds[id]
			if chance and chance > 0 then self:Text("Odds"..id, Catalog[id].name.." · "..Rules.FormatOdds(chance),15,30) end
		end
	elseif self.page == "Settings" then self:RenderSettings()
	else self:RenderTest() end
	self.content.CanvasPosition = scroll
end

function AppController:Receive(packet)
	if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.state) ~= "table" then return end
	local old = self.state
	self.state = packet.state
	local state = self.state
	self.eggs:Receive(state.eggs)
	if not old or old.plotIndex ~= state.plotIndex then self.base:RefreshPromptOwnership() end
	if self.selected and not self:Pet(self.selected) then
		local previous
		for _, pet in (old and old.pets) or {} do if pet.id == self.selected then previous = pet;break end end
		self.selected, self.confirm = nil, nil
		if previous then
			local _, byKey = self:Groups()
			local group = byKey[groupKey(previous)]
			if group then self.selected = group.representative.id end
		end
	end
	local result = packet.result
	if result and not self.mergeBrowser and (result.action=="OpenMerge" or result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") then result=nil end
	local shownRecruit, newRecruit = false, false
	self.chickenBrowser:Receive(result)
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Receive(result) end
	self.commerce:Receive(result)
	self.progression:Receive(result)
	self.upgradeBoard:Receive(result)
	self.eggBoard:Receive(result)
	if result and result.action~="RefreshShop" and result.action~="PreparePurchase" then
		local shownInMerge=result.action=="OpenMerge" or ((result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") and self.page=="Merge" and self.panel.Visible)
  if result.ok and result.action=="Buy" then shownRecruit,newRecruit=self:TrackRecruit(result) end
  if not (result.ok and (result.action=="Roll" or shownInMerge or shownRecruit)) then self:Notify(result.message,result.ok) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Buy" and not shownRecruit then self.feedback:Action("Buy");self.base:PetPulse(result.petId, C.gold) end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Sell" or result.action == "Promote") then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "OpenMerge" then self:OpenPage("Merge") end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Merge" or result.action == "MergeAll") then
			self.base:PetPulse(result.petId,C.gold)
		end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Income" or result.action == "Luck" or result.action == "Expand") then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Attack" then self:ClosePanel() end
	end
	local count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount = self:Counts()
	self.hud:Update(state, count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount)
	self.base:UpdateObjective()
	self:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if state.banner and state.banner ~= "" and state.banner ~= self.lastBanner then self:Notify(state.banner);self.lastBanner = state.banner end
	if old and state.lastResult ~= old.lastResult and not packet.result then self:Notify(state.lastResult) end
	self:RenderPanel(old == nil)
	if result and result.ok then
		local changed=if result.action=="Expand" or result.action=="Income" or result.action=="Luck" then self.progression.row else nil
		if changed then
			local name=if result.action=="Expand" then "Capacity" else result.action
			local card=changed:FindFirstChild(name)
			if card and card:FindFirstChild("Icon") then Theme.Motion:Pop(card.Icon,1.18) end
		end
		if (result.action=="Buy" and (not shownRecruit or newRecruit)) or result.action=="Expand" or result.action=="Income" or result.action=="Luck" then
			Theme.Motion:Burst(self.toastFrame,UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),C.gold)
		elseif result.action=="Sell" then Theme.Motion:Pop(self.hud.cashIcon,1.14) end
	end
end

function AppController:Start()
	self.remotes = ReplicatedStorage.PetRoll:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	self:BuildUI()
	self.upgradeBoard:Start()
	self.eggBoard:Start()
	self.audio:Start()
	self.feedback:Start()
	self.commerce:Start()
	self.eggs:Start()
	self.animator = DuckAnimator.new()
	self.animator:SetReducedMotion(self.reducedMotion)
	self.prompts=PromptStyleController.new(self)
	self.prompts:Start()
	self.base:Start()
	self.battle:Start(self.remotes:WaitForChild("BattleChanged"))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.remotes:WaitForChild("StateChanged").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet) self:Receive(packet) end))
	for _, entry in {{"Army", Enum.KeyCode.B}, {"Upgrades", Enum.KeyCode.U}, {"Settings", Enum.KeyCode.O}, {"Test", Enum.KeyCode.F8}} do
		local page, key = entry[1], entry[2]
		ContextActionService:BindAction("PetRoll" .. page, function(_, inputState)
			if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			if page == "Test" and (not self.state or not self.state.debugAllowed) then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			self:TogglePage(page)
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end, false, key)
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and self.panel.Visible then self:ClosePanel() end
	end))
	self:Request("Sync")
	print("[PetRoll] My Chicken Army! client ready")
end

function AppController:Destroy()
	self.alive = false
	Theme.Motion:Reset()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollClosePanel")
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _, page in {"Army", "Upgrades", "Settings", "Test"} do ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRoll" .. page) end
	if self.animator then self.animator:Destroy() end
	if self.prompts then self.prompts:Destroy() end
	self.commerce:Destroy();self.shopBrowser:Destroy();self.indexBrowser:Destroy()
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Destroy() end
	self.progression:Destroy()
	self.upgradeBoard:Destroy()
	self.eggBoard:Destroy()
	self.eggs:Destroy();self.base:Destroy();self.battle:Destroy();self.feedback:Destroy();self.audio:Destroy()
	self.recruitIntents,self.recruitReceipts={},{}
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

	local results=table.pack(renderPanelContent(self,...))
	Theme.ApplyPopupStyle(self.panel)

function Theme.Round(item, radius)
	local corner = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")

	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
	corner.Parent = item

end

function Theme.Stroke(item, color, thickness)
	local outline = item:FindFirstChild("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")

	outline.Thickness = thickness or 3
	outline.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

	return outline

function Theme.Gradient(item, top, bottom)

function Theme.Frame(parent, name, size, color)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

-- One tiled image per surface, independent of its size. Never build individual studs.
function Theme.Studs(parent, opacity, tilePixels, inset)
	for _,name in {"CheckerPattern","PopupStudTexture","FigmaStuds","StudPattern"} do
		local old=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	local existing=parent:FindFirstChild("StudTexture")
	if existing and not existing:IsA("ImageLabel") then existing:Destroy();existing=nil end
	local pattern = if existing and existing:IsA("ImageLabel") then existing else Theme.Image(parent,"StudTexture",Theme.Assets.Studs,UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	local padding,spacing=inset or 5,tilePixels or 28
	pattern.Image=Theme.Assets.Studs
	pattern.Size,pattern.Position=UDim2.new(1,-padding*2,1,-padding*2),UDim2.fromOffset(padding,padding)
	pattern.ScaleType, pattern.TileSize = Enum.ScaleType.Tile, UDim2.fromOffset(spacing,spacing)
	pattern.BackgroundTransparency,pattern.Active=1,false

	return pattern

function Theme.Label(parent, name, text, size, color)
	local lightSurface = parent:GetAttribute("LightSurface") == true
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name, label.Text = name, text
	label.Size, label.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28), 1
	label.Font, label.TextSize = Theme.Font, size or 20
	label.TextColor3 = color or (if lightSurface then Theme.Colors.cardInk else Theme.Colors.ink)
	label.TextXAlignment, label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.TextWrapped, label.TextStrokeTransparency, label.ZIndex = true, 1, 4
	local outline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Name,outline.Color,outline.Thickness="TextOutline",Theme.Arcade.border,math.clamp((size or 20)*0.068,1.25,4)
	outline.Enabled = not lightSurface
	outline.Parent=label

function Theme.Number(value)
	value=value or 0
	if value>=1000000 then return string.format("%.1fm",value/1000000) end
	if value>=10000 then return string.format("%.1fk",value/1000) end
	if value==math.floor(value) then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.1f",value)
end

-- Currency has whole coins. Keep exact prices readable instead of abbreviating
-- them to decimals; the floor also hides fractional frames in wallet tweens.
function Theme.Money(value)
	local whole=math.floor(value or 0)
	local digits=string.format("%.0f",math.abs(whole))
	local grouped=(digits:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,",""))
	return (if whole<0 then "-" else "")..grouped
end

function Theme.ApplyPopupStyle(panel)
	if not panel then return end
	local header=panel:FindFirstChild("Header")

		Theme.Studs(header,0.14,28,0).ZIndex=header.ZIndex
		for _,name in {"Title","PageIcon","Close"} do

			if foreground and foreground:IsA("GuiObject") then
				foreground.ZIndex=math.max(foreground.ZIndex,header.ZIndex+1)
			end
		end
	end
	local function darkSurface(item,isBody)
		item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=Color3.new(1,1,1),0
		local gradient=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(20,22,24),Color3.fromRGB(3,4,5))
		gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,if isBody then 0.24 else 0.62),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,if isBody then 0.48 else 0.80),
		})
		gradient.Rotation,gradient.Parent=90,item
		local rim=item:FindFirstChild("InnerRim")
		if rim and rim:IsA("GuiObject") then rim.Visible=false end
		local stroke=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
		if stroke then
			if isBody then
				stroke.Color,stroke.Transparency,stroke.Thickness=Color3.fromRGB(6,8,9),0.12,3
			else
				stroke.Transparency=math.max(stroke.Transparency,0.42)
				stroke.Thickness=math.min(stroke.Thickness,2)
			end
		end
	end
	local protected={
		Fill=true,ProgressFill=true,Rarity=true,RarityBadge=true,
		Badge=true,SelectionOutline=true,InnerRim=true,
	}
	local function content(item)
		if item:GetAttribute("OwnsPopupStyle")==true then return end
		if protected[item.Name] or item:IsA("ViewportFrame") then return end
		-- Action-button visuals and their captions retain their authored colors.
		if item:IsA("GuiButton") and (item:FindFirstChild("Visual") or item.Name=="Buy") then return end
		if item:IsA("Frame") or item:IsA("GuiButton") then
			if item.BackgroundTransparency<1 or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") then
				darkSurface(item,item==panel:FindFirstChild("Body"))
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Name~="TextShadow" then
			local _,_,value=item.TextColor3:ToHSV()
			if value<0.7 then
				item.TextColor3=if item.Name=="Title" or item.Name=="Current"
					then Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) else Color3.fromRGB(224,230,233)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextBox") then
			item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=Color3.fromRGB(8,10,12),0.28
			item.TextColor3,item.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,248,250),Color3.fromRGB(172,185,192)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") and item.Name=="IconRays" then
			item.ImageTransparency=math.max(item.ImageTransparency,0.9)
		end
		for _,child in item:GetChildren() do content(child) end
	end
	for _,child in panel:GetChildren() do
		if child~=header then content(child) end
	end
end

--!strict
-- Small private-game persistence owner: versioned data, atomic leases and explicit failure states.
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Config=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.Config)
local DataService={}
DataService.__index=DataService

function DataService.new(storeOverride,clockOverride,dependencies)
 dependencies=dependencies or {}
 local self=setmetatable({entries={},saving={},loading={},clock=clockOverride or os.time,closing=false,
  wait=dependencies.wait or task.wait,monotonic=dependencies.monotonic or os.clock},DataService)
 self.token=(if game.JobId~="" then game.JobId else "studio")..":"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
 self.store=storeOverride
 if not self.store and (not RunService:IsStudio() or game.GameId~=0) then
  self.store=DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.SaveName..(if RunService:IsStudio() then "_Studio" else ""))
 end
 return self
end

function DataService:Update(key,callback)
 if not self.store then return false,"This unpublished local file uses session-only progress." end
 local lastError
 for attempt=1,Config.SaveAttempts do
  local ok,value=pcall(function() return self.store:UpdateAsync(key,callback) end)
  if ok then return true,value end
  lastError=tostring(value)
  if attempt<Config.SaveAttempts then self.wait(attempt) end
 end
 return false,lastError
end

function DataService:Load(session)
 if self.entries[session.userId] or self.saving[session.userId] or self.loading[session.userId] then
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Your previous session is still saving. Rejoin shortly."
  return false,session.saveMessage
 end
 self.loading[session.userId]=true
 local key="player_"..session.userId
 local initial=session:ToData()
 local ok,record=self:Update(key,function(old)
  local now=self.clock()
  if old~=nil and (type(old)~="table" or old.schemaVersion~=1 or type(old.data)~="table") then return nil end
  if old and old.lease then
   if type(old.lease)~="table" or type(old.lease.owner)~="string" or type(old.lease.expires)~="number" or old.lease.expires~=old.lease.expires then return nil end
   if old.lease.owner~=self.token and old.lease.expires>now then return nil end
  end
  return {schemaVersion=1,data=if old then old.data else initial,
   lease={owner=self.token,expires=now+Config.SaveLeaseSeconds},updatedAt=if old then old.updatedAt else now}
 end)
 if not ok then
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Save service unavailable. Your stored progress has not been replaced."
  self.loading[session.userId]=nil
  return false,record
 end
 if not record or not record.lease or record.lease.owner~=self.token then
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Your save is busy or uses an unsupported version. Rejoin shortly."
  self.loading[session.userId]=nil
  return false,session.saveMessage
 end
 local valid,why=session:LoadData(record.data)
 if not valid then
  -- Release only our lock; keep the unrecognized player data byte-for-byte logically intact.
  self:Update(key,function(old)
   if old and old.lease and old.lease.owner==self.token then old.lease=nil;return old end
   return nil
  end)
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="This save needs recovery. It has not been overwritten."
  self.loading[session.userId]=nil
  return false,why
 end
 self.entries[session.userId]={session=session,key=key,lastSaved=self.clock(),leaseExpires=record.lease.expires,
  savedReceipts=table.clone(record.data.purchaseReceipts or {})}
 session.saveStatus="saved";session.saveMessage="Progress saved automatically."
 self.loading[session.userId]=nil
 session.loaded=true;session:Touch()
 return true,"Loaded."
end

function DataService:Save(session,release)
 local entry=self.entries[session.userId]
 if not entry or entry.session~=session or self.saving[session.userId] then return false,"No writable session, or save already running." end
 self.saving[session.userId]=true
 session.saveStatus="saving";session.saveMessage="Saving your flock…";session:Touch()
 local captured,payload=pcall(function() return entry.releasePayload or session:ToData() end)
 if not captured then
  self.saving[session.userId]=nil
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Saving interrupted. Your purchase will retry safely.";session:Touch()
  return false,tostring(payload)
 end
 local now=self.clock()
 local ok,record=self:Update(entry.key,function(old)
  if type(old)~="table" or old.schemaVersion~=1 or not old.lease or old.lease.owner~=self.token then return nil end
  return {schemaVersion=1,data=payload,updatedAt=self.clock(),
   lease=if release then nil else {owner=self.token,expires=self.clock()+Config.SaveLeaseSeconds}}
 end)
 self.saving[session.userId]=nil
 if not ok or not record then
  session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Saving interrupted. Retrying; keep this session open."
  if ok and not record then session.saveLost=true;session.saveMessage="Your save moved to another session. Rejoin to continue safely." end
  session:Touch()
  return false,if ok then "Session lock lost." else record
 end
 entry.lastSaved=now;entry.leaseExpires=now+Config.SaveLeaseSeconds
 -- Only a successful store response proves a receipt is durable. In-memory markers
 -- can also include a grant whose last save failed and must not acknowledge it yet.
 entry.savedReceipts=table.clone(record.data.purchaseReceipts or {})
 session.saveStatus="saved";session.saveMessage="Progress saved automatically.";session:Touch()
 if release then self.entries[session.userId]=nil end
 return true,"Saved."
end

function DataService:CanPurchase(session)
 local entry=session and self.entries[session.userId]
 if not self.store or not entry or entry.session~=session or not session.loaded then
  return false,"Purchases need a loaded, saved profile."
 end
 if self.closing or session.closing or session.saveLost or session.dataReleasing or entry.releasePayload
  or self.clock()>=entry.leaseExpires then
  return false,"Your save is not writable right now."
 end
 return true,"Ready."
end

function DataService:IsPurchaseSaved(session,purchaseId,productId)
 local entry=self.entries[session.userId]
 return entry~=nil and entry.session==session and entry.savedReceipts[purchaseId]==productId
end

-- Called only by the server receipt owner. grant must be nonyielding and either
-- apply the complete reward and return true, or change nothing and return false.
function DataService:CommitPurchase(session,purchaseId,productId,grant)
 local writable,why=self:CanPurchase(session)
 if not writable then return false,why end
 if self:IsPurchaseSaved(session,purchaseId,productId) then return true,"Already delivered." end
 -- An autosave may already own an older snapshot. Let it finish before adding a
 -- receipt, so that snapshot cannot overwrite a newly acknowledged purchase.
 local deadline=self.monotonic()+20
 while self.saving[session.userId] do
  if self.monotonic()>=deadline then return false,"A save is still running." end
  self.wait(0.1)
  writable,why=self:CanPurchase(session)
  if not writable then return false,why end
 end
 writable,why=self:CanPurchase(session)
 if not writable then return false,why end
 if self:IsPurchaseSaved(session,purchaseId,productId) then return true,"Already delivered." end
 local receipts=session.purchaseReceipts
 if type(receipts)~="table" then return false,"Purchase history is unavailable." end
 local previous=receipts[purchaseId]
 if previous~=nil and previous~=productId then return false,"Purchase history does not match this receipt." end
 if previous==nil then
  local applied,reason=grant()
  if not applied then return false,reason end
  receipts[purchaseId]=productId
  session:Touch()
 end
 -- No yield between grant, marker and Save's snapshot. Failed saves retain the
 -- marker in memory; a retry persists that grant without paying it twice.
 local saved,message=self:Save(session,false)
 if saved and self:IsPurchaseSaved(session,purchaseId,productId) then return true,"Delivered and saved." end
 return false,message
end

function DataService:Step()
 if self.closing then return end
 local now=self.clock()
 for id,entry in self.entries do
  local session=entry.session
  if (entry.releasePayload or not session.closing) and not self.saving[id] and now-entry.lastSaved>=Config.SaveInterval then
   -- Advance the retry clock before scheduling so a failing service cannot spawn a save every frame.
   entry.lastSaved=now
   task.spawn(function() self:Save(session,entry.releasePayload~=nil) end)
  end
  if not session.closing and now>=entry.leaseExpires then
   session.saveLost=true;session.saveStatus="error";session.saveMessage="Save connection expired. Rejoin to protect your progress."
  end
 end
end

function DataService:Release(session)
 if session.dataReleasing then return end
 session.dataReleasing=true
 local entry=self.entries[session.userId]
 if entry and entry.session==session and not entry.releasePayload then entry.releasePayload=session:ToData() end
 local deadline=os.clock()+24
 while self.saving[session.userId] and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
 if not self.saving[session.userId] then self:Save(session,true) end
 session.dataReleasing=false
end

function DataService:Close()
 self.closing=true
 for _,entry in self.entries do
  entry.session.closing=true
  task.spawn(function() self:Release(entry.session) end)
 end
 local deadline=os.clock()+25
 while next(self.entries) and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
end

return DataService
